bio.text: RaShaun Kemp, a Democrat, was elected to the Georgia State Senate in 2024 to represent District 38 and was sworn in on January 13, 2025.

According to the legislature biography, he serves as Senior Director at the National Charter Collaborative; his career also includes becoming a high school principal at age 27 and leading a state education department.
He has chaired the City of Atlanta Neighborhood Planning Unit K and is a resident of the City of South Fulton.
